subject: Post-call: Procurement & security items (PO vs card, DPA/SOC 2)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Feb 2028 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & security items (PO vs card, DPA/SOC 2)

Hi Samantha — great to meet on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what it needs:

Summary from our call:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference across customer-facing features; pilot scope is 3 services initially.
- Procurement preference: looks like Purchase Order (PO) + invoicing is preferred, finance wants net 30.
- Security gating: Acme needs SOC 2 Type II report and a signed DPA before executing PO; they also will run a short security questionnaire.

Action items / ask from Acme:
1) Confirm procurement path: PO / invoice to procurement@acme.com or do you want card for initial pilot?
2) Please send the security questionnaire when ready (or attach here) and flag any blockers.
3) Timeline: when do you expect the PO to be issued? Any internal approvals needed on your side?

What I will send by end of day:
- Redwood DPA draft
- SOC 2 summary + compliance contact
- Short note on billing/invoice flow and where to send PO

Attachments: redwood SOC2 summary + DPA (draft). If procurement prefers DocuSign for the DPA we can send that link.

Thanks — happy to sync with procurement if it'd help speed things along.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(650) 555-0182
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 13 Feb 2028 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & security items (PO vs card, DPA/SOC 2)

Thanks Marissa — quick replies inline:

- Procurement prefers PO / invoice (net 30). Please send invoices to procurement@acme.com and copy accounts-payable@acme.com.
- We require a signed DPA before the PO is approved.
- SOC 2 Type II report is required; if you can provide the most recent report or a SOC 2 summary that will be fine for initial review.
- Attached: Acme_security_questionnaire_v3.xlsx — our security team will fill and return within 5 business days.

Tentative timeline: I expect procurement to review once they have the DPA and SOC2 summary; PO issuance mid next week if everything looks good.

Can you confirm Redwood's billing entity and where to send the PO? Also, do you support marketplace purchases (AWS Marketplace)? That could be preferable to our finance team.

Thanks,
Samantha

—
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Feb 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & security items (PO vs card, DPA/SOC 2)

Marissa / Rishi —

Quick internal notes based on Samantha's reply:
- Prepare DPA draft and SOC 2 summary for Acme immediately. I'll pull the most recent SOC 2 attestation and a one-page summary that highlights scoping (infra & platform) and controls.
- Legal should be ready to accept reasonable DPA redlines; if procurement pushes heavy IP or liability edits we may need legal review.
- Commercial: confirm billing entity and AP contact. We should offer both options: (1) send PO to invoices@redwood.com (Redwood USA, Inc.), net 30; (2) AWS Marketplace option — confirm marketplace SKU/pricing and any delta.

I'll coordinate with Finance to confirm PO acceptance details and to prepare the DocuSign link for the DPA if that helps speed signature.

-David

David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2028 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & security items (PO vs card, DPA/SOC 2)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are:
- redwood_dpa_2028-02-14.pdf (draft DPA)
- redwood_soc2-summary_2028-02.pdf (SOC 2 Type II summary)

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement: please confirm PO send-to address (invoices@redwood.com) and billing entity: Redwood USA, Inc. If you'd like net 30 on PO please indicate on the PO.
2) If you'd prefer DocuSign for the DPA we can send a link — otherwise accept the attached PDF and return signed to contracts@redwood.com.
3) We can also list the purchase through AWS Marketplace; Rishi can provide SKU/pricing and whether any marketplace fees apply.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_2028-02-14.pdf (DPA draft), redwood_soc2-summary_2028-02.pdf (SOC 2 summary). I'll follow up on Friday if we haven't received the filled questionnaire.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this to PO.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(650) 555-0182
